name: goal_agent
description: Persistent, goal-directed agent that tracks a measurable KPI over a quarter or longer. Supports create/check-in, list, and kill subcommands. Reads metrics from Stripe, GitHub, SSH, or custom URLs; dispatches Devin/Cursor agents for corrective action; and stores state across runs.

goal_name.description: Human-readable name for the goal (e.g. 'rcmapi-revenue'). Used as the unique identifier.

target_metric.description: Description of what is being measured (e.g. 'Monthly revenue USD').

metric_source.description: Where to read the current metric value. { type: 'stripe' | 'github' | 'ssh_command' | 'custom_url', config: {...} }

config.description: Backend-specific config (e.g. { endpoint, api_key } for stripe; { repo, path, ref, jq } for github; { command, host } for ssh_command; { url, method, headers, json_path } for custom_url).

deadline.description: ISO date for the goal deadline (e.g. '2026-09-30').

check_cadence.description: Cron expression for check-in frequency (e.g. '0 9 * * 1' for weekly Monday 9am). Stored for scheduling reference.

subcommand.description: Operation to perform. 'create' (default) creates a goal or runs a check-in. 'list' shows all active goals. 'kill' removes a goal agent.
